verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents creating person, business, and account applications and plugging in a bank-approved KYC/KYB vendor. The pack has no evidence of an onboarding queue, reasons an application is pending, a way to supply additional documents, or any split between ops-user and bank decisions. Creating applications and integrating KYC are adjacent features, not this ops-queue workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can work the onboarding queue — see why an application is pending, supply additional documents, and understand which decisions are mine versus the bank's
